headline: Keith Tyser’s team slips out of ARC-2 gold

sections.text: この遥かなる旅路に祝福を fell from 16th to 18th at 69.72, unchanged, and lost its place among the 16 gold teams.
The team had entered the gold places at 16th in a report earlier this week; the cutoff now stands at 70.14.
